evidence_note: RETROSPECTIVE, not pre-registered: built after the election with the result and market resolutions known. The v1 headline settings use the 2021 night only. The v2 and v3 sensitivities were also chosen after the 2025 result was known; v2 applies a fixed multi-night rule (only 2021 is replayable); v3 adds a poll-tilted prior and re-chooses the settings on 2021 and simulated 2017 orders. No version uses the 2025 count to select settings.
settle_gated_note: per race (its first market): gate = first minute with >= 1% of the electorate counted; model = max(model settle, gate); lead = Polymarket settle - gated model settle, minutes (settle = staying >= 0.9 on the outcome to the end of the night, 07:00 CET)

reasons.capacity: no trading rule was run in this replay
reasons.profit: no trading rule was run in this replay
reasons.arbitrage: Kalshi lists no thin-spread pairs through the count (its 'parties in parliament' markets closed 15:00 UTC, before polls closed)
reasons.calibration: minutes from 1% to 95% counted (electorate share); the party's projected final second-vote share against the official final, 90% band from the 2021-calibrated sd
reasons.settle.kalshi: Kalshi traded only the 'most seats' and '2nd place' markets through the count, thinly (12 to 23 one-minute candles each)

accuracy.pwin_window: contested = the markets Polymarket had not settled (>= 0.9 on the outcome to the end) before the first count information; minutes from then to the last national page
accuracy.outcome: Polymarket resolution (identical to the official final, Bundeswahlleiterin 14 March 2025)

brier_by_counted.window: minutes from the first count information to the last national page (2025-02-23T19:38:00Z to 2025-02-24T00:33:37Z)

unavailable_nights.2017: one stamped Wahlkreis page; not replayable
unavailable_nights.2013: no result-page captures during election night

market_classification.definition: eventual outcome >= 0.90 at the first minute at/after official poll close and never below 0.80 afterwards

v3.label: v3: poll prior + recalibrated (chosen after the result was known)
v3.note: The prior is the 2021 result on the 2025 constituencies tilted to the mean of the 25 polls that ended 10-22 February 2025 (proportional swing per party), its weight fades as the count arrives, and the band, the Land shrinkage and the correlations were re-chosen on 2021 (real archived order) and 2017 (simulated orders) with the same kind of poll prior; before the first count page the band is the historical error of final-fortnight poll averages (2013, 2017, 2021). Nothing from the 2025 count, prices or the exit poll is an input, but it was designed after the result was known: a sensitivity, not a forecast. The model's chance exists from poll close (17:00 UTC), before any count.
calibration_nights: 2021 (real archived order, 2017 prior tilted to the 2021 polls)
2017 (21 simulated orders, 2013 prior tilted to the 2017 polls)

v2.label: v2: common rule on the only replayable earlier night (chosen after the result was known)
